services.value: Universal Laboratories provides environmental sampling and analytical testing services, including microbiological testing (e.g., sterility checks, effectiveness testing, spore count on autoclaves), inorganic and organic chemistry testing (classical wet chemistry, trace metals, extraction techniques, and Gas Chromatography/Gas chromatography mass spectrometer testing with USEPA testing methods). They also offer field sampling services such as routine sample pick-up, permit sampling/support for industrial wastewater permits, stormwater outfalls sampling, and compliance-related services like permit management, DMR preparation, electronic reporting, river and stream monitoring, and groundwater sampling and analysis.
